instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\base.dxf, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\arm.dxf, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\bracket.dxf, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\pin.dxf, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cap.dxf. Import base.dxf, arm.dxf, bracket.dxf, cap.dxf, and pin.dxf. Draw a robotic fixture layout: base rectangle (0,0)-(180,45), arm rectangle (40,55)-(155,75), triangular bracket with vertices (20,45), (70,45), (20,95), cap rectangle (155,52)-(185,78), pin circles at (55,65) and (155,65) radius 7, and text ACAD-33. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
